composites.name: serpentinizing_vent_reactor
composites.description: A reusable alkaline-vent reactor module. Module A = genuine PHREEQC serpentinization (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat): olivine dissolution + serpentine/brucite/magnetite equilibrium gives dissolved H2 (reducing power), alkalinity, heat, pe, and a charge-balanced fluid. Module B = genuine FiPy finite-volume advection-diffusion-reaction column transporting those sources across the vent-ocean interface and setting outlet T/pH/porosity. PHREEQC conserves mass+charge and FiPy's FVM conserves flux, satisfying the og-00 contract invariants. Requires phreeqpython + fipy.

olivine_rate.description: Olivine dissolution rate (mol per flow-saturated reaction step)

nx.description: FiPy finite-volume cells across the interface column

composites.description: Reduced tuned-relaxation vent reactor (fallback / A-B comparison): Gaussian serpentinization source feeding a first-order relaxation box. Runs anywhere (no phreeqpython/fipy). NOT real geochemistry.

composites.name: hydrothermal_carbon_fixation
composites.description: A reusable H2/pH-driven carbon-fixation module. Module C = genuine FiPy Nernst-Planck pH-gradient electrochemistry (pmf, current density). Module D = genuine eQuilibrator ΔG' feasibility gate + lab-calibrated (Preiner/Hudson) mineral-catalyzed CO2 reduction to formate/acetate/pyruvate. gradient_efficiency=1.0 is the favorable arm; ~0.1 is the Tutolo-2026 in-situ collapse. catalyst_active/h2=0 give the controls. Requires equilibrator_api + fipy.

gradient_efficiency.description: Usable fraction of the geochemical ΔpH at in-situ T/P (1.0 favorable; ~0.1 Tutolo-2026 collapse; 0 = no-gradient control)

catalyst_active.description: Active Fe/Ni/S mineral catalyst (0 = no-catalyst control)

Emergent: sustained carbon throughput, an autocatalytic motif (gain>1), and a connected reaction network. Requires tellurium + networkx.

composites.name: thermophoretic_concentration
composites.description: A reusable thermophoretic-concentration module for the Baaske thermal trap. Module F = genuine FiPy finite-volume accumulation column: thermophoresis (Soret) + buoyant convection concentrate a dilute feed, enrichment exponential in pore length (>10^8 favorable, ~1 in controls). flow_velocity=0 / porosity=1 give the no-trap controls. Requires fipy.

flow_velocity.description: Buoyant convective flow in the pore (m/s); 0 = no-convection control

config.title: Campaign III — the thermal trap concentrates an individual

composites.name: mixed_amphiphile_protocell
composites.description: A reusable mixed-amphiphile protocell module (Module G). Coarse-grained vesicle self-assembly + permeability calibrated to Jordan 2019: mixed single-chain amphiphiles broaden the pH / salt / divalent stability window and form vesicles that retain chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient (individuality without isolation). mix_fraction≈0 / high salt / acidic pH give the controls. Coarse-grained reproduction (not wrapped MD).

mix_fraction.description: Co-surfactant fraction (0 = single fatty acid; higher = broader Jordan window)

config.title: Campaign IV — the protocell window broadens (mixed amphiphiles)

composites.name: bioenergetic_internalization
composites.description: A reusable bioenergetic-internalization module (Module H). An evolutionary control loop (replicator dynamics, Sojo-2014 leaky-membrane fitness) under a declining external gradient: as the geochemical pmf collapses, an efficient-pump population internalizes gradient generation and persists, while a weak-pump control collapses (the Sojo constraint). catalyst_efficiency sets the arm. Coarse-grained, deterministic reproduction (not wrapped ALife).

config.title: Campaign V — selection internalizes the gradient

composites.name: heredity_module_comparison
composites.description: A reusable heredity-module comparison (Module J). Genuine libRoadRunner quasispecies replicator (Eigen error threshold): a heredity module (RNA-like / peptide / low-fidelity / non-heritable) replicates a polymer with whole-sequence fidelity Q = fidelity^length; above the threshold the functional information is retained and inheritance pays, below it errors win. Compares modules head-to-head on lineage fitness. Requires tellurium/libroadrunner.

module.description: Heredity-module preset: rna-like | peptide | low-fidelity | non-heritable
